connector_readiness.description: Each operation the method may call, as ready as the project leaves it.

distribution_digest.description: The distribution digest: the package digest of the package `runx registry package` makes of this one, which every published, bundled or served copy carries and a load of one binds. A source directory's differs from its package digest once packaging adds what the package carries; a copy that already is a distribution states its own. None when the package doesn't package, as a publish would refuse it, or when the inspection was given no environment to package it in.

entry_provenance.description: Where the inspected package came from, when a resolver found it.

environment.description: The environment the method reads, by name and availability, never by value.

method.description: The method inspected: the one named, else the default.

method_inspections.description: Each method with the closure it binds.

methods.description: Every method the package declares, by name.

package_digest.description: The execution package digest, as a run records it; a listing's package digest is the registry's digest of the published files.
